verdict.rationale: Yubico ships programmatic surfaces, including SDKs, the ykman CLI and the YubiEnterprise REST API, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. Package release numbers (ykman 5.9.2, fido2 2.2.1) and firmware versions are not a versioned API with a published deprecation or sunset policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
